follow-up time: Duration of the study period (before and after intervention)
exposure: Educational program and modified guidelines for oxytocin use
outcome: Prevalence and duration of oxytocin treatment
cohort: 1095 first-time mothers at term with spontaneous onset of labor
finding: While the intervention led to a significant reduction in oxytocin use, operative vaginal births appear to be associated with oxytocin treatment, suggesting that augmentation with oxytocin should be used cautiously and only when medically indicated.
mod_finding: The intervention led to a moderate reduction in operative vaginal deliveries, but a moderate increase in caesarean sections, although dystocia as an indication for these deliveries did not increase.
